svg.text: Both machines join thioester-tethered building blocks — an amine attacks for NRPS, a decarboxylated carbanion attacks for PKS.
The condensation (C) domain joins two amino acids — the downstream amine attacks the upstream thioester.
The ketosynthase (KS) domain joins two acyl units — malonyl loses CO₂, and the carbanion attacks the thioester.
